Dis-lui simplement ce que tu veux entend: Just tell it what you want to hear: “SCH-style vocals”, “soft R&B like SZA”, “airy and dark”. Or drop onto the sphere a track whose vocals you love. It listens to your take for ten seconds, then builds the whole chain for you: cleanup, tuning, EQ, compression, space. And it explains each of its choices, like an engineer sitting next to you would.
Ensuite, tu affines comme tu parlerais à: Then you fine-tune the way you'd talk to your engineer: “a bit less reverb”, “more upfront”, “darker”. Or you grab the four big knobs: PRESENCE, WARMTH, SUSTAIN, SPACE.
Et si tu veux mettre les mains dedans, t: And if you want to get hands-on, everything is there, in the order you want: • Cleanup: de-click, de-breath, de-reverb, noise gate, denoiser, plosives, resonances, de-esser • Tone: ONIRIQUE TUNER, N73 preamp, 8-band parametric EQ, analog EQ, Saturation Lab • Dynamics: 1176, CL1B tube, LA-2A, multiband, parallel compression • Effects: reverb, tempo-synced delay, doubler, chorus, flanger, telephone
